tools.name: searchCruises
tools.description: Search upcoming cruise sailings by destination, region, dates, length (nights "lo:hi"), cruise line, ship, departure port, ports of call, cabin type, budget, family fit and more. Pass the full filter set; omitted fields are unfiltered. Returns the match count, cheapest fare, top lines, the 10 soones

tools.name: compareSailings
tools.description: Compare 2–3 specific sailings side by side: dates, ports, price and price per night, price verdict against the six-month average, ship age and size, family suitability, rating with review count and CDC inspection score. Takes sailing ids from searchCruises.

tools.name: getPriceHistory
tools.description: Judge one sailing's current fare: six-month price history, average, percent above or below it, a verdict, and whether it is on today's price-drop list. Takes a sailing id from searchCruises.

tools.name: getPriceDrops
tools.description: The biggest current cruise price drops: cabin type, current and average price, percent dropped, sail date and a booking link.

tools.name: getCabinDetail
tools.description: One specific cabin by ship and room number: deck, side and position, category with size and how many it sleeps, connecting cabin, known issues (obstructed view, noise, long walk) and what cruisers who stayed there said. "No issues recorded" is not a guarantee of none.

tools.name: getShipCabins
tools.description: A ship's cabins grouped by type (inside, ocean view, balcony, suite): categories, cabin counts, size range, how many they sleep, and the line's guarantee categories.

tools.name: getShipProfile
tools.description: One ship: year built and refurbished, size, guests and crew, cabin counts, rating and attribute scores, family suitability, CDC inspection score, venues and editorial. For whether a ship has a venue and which deck it is on, use getDeckPlan; for where it is right now, getShipPosition; for its cruise

tools.name: getCruiseLineProfile
tools.description: One cruise line: who it is best and not for, descriptions by traveler type, ratings with review counts, attribute ratings, tier (mainstream, premium, luxury, river) and fleet size.

tools.name: getDressCode
tools.description: A cruise line's dress code: overall style, daytime and evening rules, formal nights and how often, jeans/shorts/swimwear rules, venue rules and theme nights.

tools.name: getPortGuide
tools.description: Guide to a cruise port: what it is like, where it is, things to do, beaches, shopping, terminals, safety score, wifi and car rental.

tools.name: getPortExcursions
tools.description: Bookable shore excursions and resort day passes in a cruise port, with price, duration, rating and a link. Pass activity (e.g. "scuba", "ATV tours") to narrow to that kind of excursion, with its total, and minPrice/maxPrice to narrow by price. To narrow an earlier answer by price, call again with th

tools.name: getSailingExcursions
tools.description: Shore excursions for every port of one sailing in one call, in itinerary order: hours ashore at each port, up to three picks that fit the time ashore (with an hour to spare before all aboard) and each port's total. Pass a sailing id from searchCruises, or ship plus sail date. activity and minPrice/m

tools.name: getBestTimeToVisit
tools.description: Month-by-month average temperature and rainfall for a cruise port, region or destination, with the warmest and driest months. A place with very different sub-regions returns a list to choose from.

tools.name: getDeckPlan
tools.description: Where things are on a ship, from its deck plans: whether a ship has a venue or facility and which deck it is on (pass venue, e.g. "pizza", "theater", "Windjammer"), with forward/midship/aft and port/starboard; what is on one deck (pass deck, e.g. "10"); or, with neither, the ship's decks with a few

tools.name: getShipPosition
tools.description: Where a ship is right now: in port (and when it leaves), at sea between two ports (how far across, next arrival), or between sailings, with the stops coming up, approximate coordinates, and links to its tracker map and sailing. Estimated from the sailing's schedule and charted route, not a live GPS

tools.name: getCruiseDirector
tools.description: Who is the cruise director on a Carnival or Royal Caribbean ship today, on a date or on one sailing, with who is next; or which ship a named director is on and where next. With a sailing (sailingId, or ship plus sail date) it also links that sailing's roll call page, where cruisers booked on it meet

tools.name: getDrinkPackages
tools.description: Beverage-package details by cruise line: package names, maximum drink value, daily limits and gratuity.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: getCabinDetail · Private data: getDeckPlan · Public sink: getDeckPlan · Destructive: getPriceHistory.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: getCabinDetail · Private data: getDeckPlan · Public sink: getDeckPlan · Destructive: getPriceHistory

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
